provenance: Reviewer independently derived from current source materials and raw CSV. Existing candidate plan used only to identify requested coverage; no author directory, generated metrics SQL, library output, or actual test result read to determine expected values.

common.effective_order: status=paid AND paid_cents-refund_cents>0. cancelled, full refund and paid zero net excluded; partial refund remains valid if positive.
common.time: date, Asia/Shanghai, [start,end), refund snapshot attributed to original order date
common.comparison: compare each metric and group identity; exact integers, predetermined ratio tolerance; reject missing/extra/duplicate groups, wrong units/time/filters; null!=0; unordered rows allowed
common.non_ok: clarify/unsupported/error only status plus supported version locks; do not force ok fields or invented null figures

B5.registration: members at account grain, registered_at selects window independently of orders. Include no-purchase accounts. home_store_id and current tier permitted; never substitute order store or historical-tier claim. count unit.
B5.ranking: Within manifest coverage, filter effective orders then sort per member_id by ordered_at ASC, order_id ASC. Select first row once, following rows repeat. Rank over full observed coverage before window selection.
B5.first_metrics: first_buyer_count distinct account count of chosen first rows in window; first_order_count chosen first orders; first_order_sales_cents sum paid-refund only for those exact first rows. Need ID ledger beyond matching totals.
B5.repeat: all rank>=2 effective orders in window, not repeat accounts or same-month repeat buyers
B5.filters: First order identity is global within coverage. Apply explicitly supported order/channel/store selection after identifying first/repeat orders; filtering cannot relabel a subsequent order first. Source 03 explicitly says full coverage and first before window; post-channel/filter semantics are reviewer derivation, not a separate quoted customer authorization. Dimension reachability remains build-stage obligation.
B5.cross_assertion: B5-A01 consume existing same-dataset, same-window numerical case outputs/ledger without duplicate natural language query. first buyers=first orders; first orders+repeat orders=valid orders. Each component still needs independent expected and exact first IDs.

B6.aggregation: First filter effective orders. Group by (calendar month, member_id), count orders. >=1 buyer; >=2 repeat buyer. Ratio repeat accounts/buyer accounts, not all registered, order count, or average per-group ratios. units count/count/ratio.
B6.calendar: Complete natural months only, full stores. Multiple complete months must be separate monthly rows; each month deduplicates independently, not sum monthly distinct as global people. A member with one valid order each in two months is a buyer each month but repeat neither.
B6.zero: Covered no-purchase month ungrouped is [0,0,null]; uncovered period is unsupported. A month with buyers but no repeat is ratio 0. Missing grouped month rows are not automatically zero; if authors require full output calendar they must explicitly source/implement calendar completion.
